summary:
**TerraTwin – Earth Analog Discovery Platform**

TerraTwin is a geospatial research platform designed to identify Earth locations that resemble selected regions of the Moon and Mars. It helps researchers, students, and space enthusiasts explore planetary terrain by comparing geographical and topographical characteristics using GIS-based analysis.

The platform uses NASA planetary datasets and Earth elevation datasets, including Copernicus DEM, to extract terrain features and calculate similarity scores. Its similarity-ranking algorithm identifies and ranks potential Earth analog locations based on dimensionless terrain-shape characteristics. The system includes an interactive 3D visualization of Earth, Moon, and Mars, analog location mapping, comparison results, and an AI-powered research assistant using Google Gemini.

TerraTwin aims to make planetary terrain research more accessible, visual, and understandable. It can support preliminary planetary exploration studies, research planning, educational activities, and the identification of potential Earth environments for analog research.
details:
TerraTwin – Earth Analog Discovery Platform

TerraTwin is a geospatial platform that identifies Earth locations with terrain characteristics similar to selected regions of the Moon and Mars. Users can explore interactive 3D models of Earth, Moon, and Mars, select planetary locations, and discover potential Earth analogs through GIS-based terrain analysis.

The platform processes geographical and elevation data, extracts terrain features, and uses a dimensionless terrain-shape similarity algorithm to calculate similarity scores and rank potential Earth locations. It also provides interactive maps, visual comparisons, and a Gemini-powered AI research assistant to help users understand the results.

Benefits and Intended Impact: TerraTwin makes planetary terrain research more accessible and visual. It can support preliminary research, educational activities, planetary exploration planning, and the identification of potential terrestrial analog environments.

Technology Used: Python, JavaScript, React.js, Three.js, Node.js, FastAPI, Google Gemini API, GIS tools, and geospatial datasets. The project was developed using standard computer hardware without requiring specialized equipment.

Creativity and Innovation: The project combines planetary 3D visualization, geospatial similarity ranking, interactive mapping, and AI-assisted explanations in one platform. Instead of simply displaying planetary images, it connects planetary terrain characteristics with real locations on Earth.

Factors Considered: Dataset availability, geographical accuracy, terrain characteristics, resolution differences, data quality, computational feasibility, usability, and transparency of similarity results. The current prototype provides preliminary terrain-shape comparisons, with scope for incorporating additional datasets and environmental parameters in the future.
